title: leanctx.hive.event/v2 envelope with server fields (SPEC-CONTRACT-SERVER §3.5–§3.8)
description: Signed fields: every member except body, ck_wrapped, signature and the server fields (seq, received_at, provenance, review_state, reviewed_by, review_id, batch_id, purged, revoked_signer, legacy). Shape refusals map to `invalid_event` `reason: shape`.

ck_wrapped.description: base64url (no padding) of nonce(24) ‖ ciphertext(32) ‖ tag(16)

allOf.$comment: Signer class W (actor.kind = worker): worker_id, capture and screening required; cause and origin forbidden (R5, §3.11 step 2).
node_type exactly on node.add; target on every op except purge.

then.$comment: Purge tombstones: server only, Hive-signed, no target, no cause (§3.5, §3.6).

allOf.$comment: Body present unless purged (purged: true → body absent).
Sealed places (epoch present): ck_wrapped and flags required, body is ciphertext. Plain places: no ck_wrapped, body per op.
A plaintext body with a `legacy` member only from actor.kind = legacy_import (§3.7 R70: native `legacy` refused `shape`).
field.set of legacy.doc_index only by legacy_import.

legacy_node.$comment: 1.x values verbatim (R70); doc_index only from legacy_import (enforced at envelope level).

claim_limits.$comment: v4 limits; a body with evidence = imported and a `legacy` member gets the 1.x limits instead (§3.7 R70).

allOf.$comment: anchors required when applies_to names code (file:/sym:)

field.$comment: Union of the mutable fields of §3.7; the per-type check needs the folded node (server/engine).

code_anchor.description: CodeAnchorV1 (lead addition 24.10.): ref file:<path> or sym:<path>::<symbol>; digest = sha256 hex of the anchored content (file bytes, or the symbol's source span); commit = the git commit the digest was taken at; verified_at = when an engine last re-anchored it

push_request.description: E5 POST /v1/places/{p}/events; a batch is not atomic: every event is decided on its own, in batch order (§3.11)

conversion.description: E5 batch member of a conversion push (R59, R90): the lease holder's re-pushed events cover original seqs from_seq..to_seq (v2_plain) of the vault

conversion_lease_response.description: E38a answer: 10 min, renewed by repeating; conversion_from_seq only for v2_plain

conversion_done_request.description: E38 source v2_plain (R90): Ed25519 by the instance key over signing_input_without_signature("leanctx.hive.conversion_done.v1\n", body); paged in parts of <= 10 000 seq_digests; the legacy form (R74) comes with migrate-v4

seq_digests.description: every seq <= conversion_from_seq the lease holder converts: not purged and not an op=purge tombstone (tombstones are server-only and never copied, R136); a seq the engine cannot verify is not re-signed, the conversion then waits for another member after the lease expires

conversion_done_part_response.description: E38 202 after an earlier part (the last part answers 204 without a body)
